newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai ExIm bank sees 14 pct profit rise in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Thai ExIm bank sees 14 pct profit rise in 1997.

text.p: Thailand's Export-Import Bank said on Wednesdy it expects to post a 700 million baht ($27.13 million) net profit in 1997 against 615 million last year and 501 million in 1995.
"We target the bank's net profit to grow 14 percent to 700 million baht this year," exim bank president Pridiyathorn Devakul told a news conference.
He said the bank's outstanding export credits granted to Thai exporters rose to 12.35 billion baht at end-1996 from 6.10 billion a year ago.
Pridiyathorn said his bank granted 5.72 billion baht loans for nine Thai projects abroad last year.
He said most of the projects were in neighbouring countries including a new international airport at Mandalay in Burma.
The exim bank is weighing loan applications for 28 Thai investment projects in Laos, Burma, Vietnam, China and Indonesia.
